talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 18 solo PCPs winding down in West Virginia; 2 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Beckley 25801, Fairmont 26554) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~2,665 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Clay County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 13 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~33,600 patients across 28 at-risk practices statewide.
